non_blocking.section: Metrics catalog; Grafana dashboards and SLOs (SLO-GW-4)
non_blocking.suggestion: Line 203 defines `ruralz_plugin_call_overhead_seconds` as "instance checkout to guest entry and guest return to call end". SM-6 measures a "pooled instance", and pool wait has its own histogram, `ruralz_plugin_pool_wait_seconds`. State that checkout time excludes the wait for a free instance. Otherwise SLO-GW-4 burns during pool contention, which SM-6 does not measure.

Line 43: "For OQ-tech-stack-and-libraries-16 this document recommends one `/metrics` exporter reading the OTLP aggregates". The Open question lists two options: the OTel Prometheus exporter and the Prometheus client. Name the option being recommended, or say that neither fits Ruralz-owned aggregates and add it as a third option. Name no library until the tech stack document adds a catalog row (pack section 7, Pending selections).

Security and identity line 409 refers to "per-cause refusal counters proposed to Observability" for the credential hash queue but names none. Say that `ruralz_auth_decisions_total{result="deny", code}` carries them, or add a named counter, so the two documents agree.
OQ-observability-2, Blocking column: "Yes, for TLS export (M1)". Use the milestone tag form, "Yes, for TLS export, Planned (M1)", to match OQ-observability-19.
`last_updated: 2026-09-23` predates this revision. Set it to the revision date.
